retrieved.title: Replacement Parts Process
retrieved.heading: Wrong or defective replacement parts
retrieved.text: If Fernhollow sends the wrong part, or the replacement part is defective, tell Customer care or the Quality team. Partners should use the Partner Defect Report Procedure for repeat problems. Send the part number, the packing slip, and photos. Keep the wrong part until staff give instructions.

retrieved.title: Returns and Damaged-on-Arrival Policy for Customers
retrieved.heading: What to send
retrieved.text:
Send Customer care these items:
1. Your order number.
2. The model, such as FH-340 wood chipper.
3. The serial number from the label.
4. Photos of the problem.
5. A short description of what happened.
Use the web form on example.com or call 555-0100 during office hours.

retrieved.title: Freight Damage and Shipment Discrepancy Claims
retrieved.heading: Wrong items or short quantities
retrieved.text: Compare the packing list with the items you received. Tell the Quality team which items are wrong or missing. Do not return anything until the Quality team gives instructions.
